description: Foundation Rail Infrastructure is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The Foundation Rail Infrastructure feature dataset is part of the Foundation Spatial Data Framework theme for Transport. The Foundation Rail Infrastructure feature dataset is specifically made up of Rail line features (Railways, Rail Sidings and Tramline including Light Rail) and Rail points (Stations). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, Foundation, Light Rail, Published_External, Rail. It offers 6 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, WFS, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
